description: ROUTE a theme basket trade through the platform's optimised execution pipelines, read-only: the ticket split over the basket legs, every leg quoted across every venue — DEX aggregators, the EventTrader order book and, when connected, the user's own exchange (CEX) — and the venue with the best net output chosen per leg (stock legs: Brokerage100 delivery). Shows best CEX vs best DEX per leg, the expected output and the routing parameters in force (tuned daily by the optimizer). Nothing is placed; call theme_journey_trade to place it. (no key needed)

conversation_id.description: conversation_id returned by an earlier theme_journey_* call (keeps an anonymous visitor's interests and basket together until they register).

usdc_amount.description: ticket size in USDC (the user's own money)
